notes.title: Update 0.14.4
notes.content:
In this patch we replace Anthia's face and improve her appearance. There are also some small bugs fixed and minor paladin balance fixes.

FIXES:
- Removed some null references in code
- If host still in game while client in menu, don't play portal entry sound
- Enemy walk animations sometimes not triggered (experimental fix)
- Enemy rubber banding after finishing attacks

CHANGES:
- Replaced Anthia's face and improved her appearance
- Bumped Unity version
- Improved item and hero preview lighting
- Made trap tips text block the view less

BALANCE:
- Bolter - Physical damage: 4.5 -> 5.
- Iron pill - Physical damage taken: 30% -> 35%

notes.title: Short update about act 2
notes.content: [p]There is so much going into making a game, you wouldn't believe. Or maybe you would, if you've been dabbling in making interactive content. Any-a-who, I needed to replace an SSD so while I'm waiting for everything to be done file-wise with the new drive, why not post a lesser update?[/p][p]At the moment, the block of content being worked on is the one with all the new fun monsters of act 2. This means to (sometimes in an annoyingly iterating loop) do something like this...[/p][p][/p][h3]Blender[/h3][list][*][p]Model the monster; vertices + lines + polygons, all sorts of shenanigans.[/p][/*][*][p]Rig the monster; create a skeleton that covers bigger and smaller limbs (down to each individual knuckle sometimes).[/p][/*][*][p]Weight paint; make sure all parts of the model know what bone(s) they're influenced by.[/p][/*][*][p]Animate; make all necessary idle, walk, attack, get up, etc. animations.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Substance Painter[/h3][list][*][p]Texture; putting that lipstick on. Make them look good enough to play with.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Audacity[/h3][list][*][p]Record; grunt and scream in a microphone until the neighbors call the police on you.[/p][/*][*][p]Edit audio; reverberate, normalize, remove bad audio, etc.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Unity[/h3][list][*][p]Add a ragdoll; make them be able to fall down well. Don't have their head fall down into their chest, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Configure/balance; give them values like speed, attack speed, attack damage, elemental immunities.[/p][/*][*][p]Special logic; many of the new monsters have their own ability that set them apart from their brethren.[/p][/*][*][p]Put them in game; put them in the right levels, in the right waves, in the right numbers for 1-4 players.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Many of these steps can be slightly easier by sometimes extrapolating from an existing enemy model, finding a suitable metarig that's close enough (and remove several, like hundreds, of facial bones), finding the right "whoosh" sound in a bought sound library to expand upon, and so on. But all in all, it takes a lot of time to just get a single monster done.[/p][p][/p][p]That's it for the small update, I think. The SSD is usable soon![/p][p][/p][p]Here are some of the upcoming act 2 monsters. I wonder if you can spot something special about them, like if they have an ability that will have you cursing worse then when you faced your first Voodoo Mishap.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791033/3c04efa5bf10a65c236dc51092ad106a4b430a55.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.14.3
notes.content:
This is mainly a balance patch. Patches are few and far between right now as the main work is still being done on creating content for act 2 but I wanted to get at least something out before act 2 rolls out.

CHANGES:
- Show available levels of an upgrade even if it is fully upgraded
- Enemy path guides reworked, less CPU intensive

ADDITIONS:
- Text indicator if a potion is taken/consumed

BALANCE:
- Every round of every level now slightly easier to help with skill issues (please, try "casual" difficulty also)

notes.title: Update 0.14.2
notes.content:
Another huge patch, a few months in the making.
After this one, it's full steam ahead trying to get act 2 out.

FIXES:
- Memory leak after ending a level
- Hero animations have wrongly been 24 fps instead of 25 since a few months ago
- Enemy stats modifiers calculated more exactly
- Melee enemies swing more accurately at their target
- Changed how client actions are cancelled, might remove rare cases when Electrum gets stuck on nothing
- Looping ambient level sounds didn't care for volume settings
- Adventure modifier for pickup radius was wrong
- Some rounding issues in the arsenal
- Visual inconsistencies with some upgrades in the arsenal
- Paladin "more damage" aura not applied to every damage type
- Damage modifiers calculations more consistent (and more correct)
- An insane amount of bug fixes

CHANGES:
- More traps/skins have better visibility in-game
- Slightly more control while in mid-air
- Portal icons in minimap are now animated and shown even if not on same height layer
- "Final wave!" text after countdown when it's the final wave
- Slightly easier to see which enemy entrances are active every wave
- Stats in arsenal are now also calculated based on selected curios
- Stats in arsenal now show how their values are calculated
- "Accuracy" has now mostly been replaced with "Spread" in arsenal upgrades
- Better minion AI
- Better enemy AI
- Upgrade system completely re-written
- Stats upgrades now shown with markers instead of numbers

ADDITIONS:
- Save/load upgrade templates (e.g. "anti-fliers" or "traps ftw !!1!")
- Minions' active commands now visible with icons and lines

BALANCE:
- Harder enemy variants now have more resistances
- Tweaked attack distances of melee enemies and minions
- Tweaked (mostly increased) values of weapons, traps, upgrades, minions and curios

notes.title: Update 0.14.1
notes.content:
Here is a patch for you audiophiles! And everyone else.

FIXES:
- Bolters will no longer shoot recently deceased recently deceased
- Bomb lobber sounds often didn't play
- Timing issues in cutscenes
- Impaler model slightly smaller to avoid sticking out of walls
- Contrary to games in general, the startup animation now takes volume settings into account
- Adventure modifier visual glitches removed

CHANGES:
- Sound effect falloff changed, better culling and priorities of different sound effects
- Rebalanced sound volumes of most sound effects
- Nicer looking subtitles
- Many trap skins are now easier to see in-game

ADDITIONS:
- Different reverb settings in different places in the levels
- Lava gets a sound loop
- Portal gets a sound loop
- Torches get a sound loop
- Boomstick's secondary attack now has different sounds per skin

BALANCE:
- Graveler damage nerfed
- Adventures a bit easier but consolation points when losing are fewer

notes.title: Update 0.14.0
notes.content:
Patch 0.14.0 is out now and it's a huge one.

FIXES:
- If walking and starting to chat, don't have walk keys get stuck
- Bad loop of music on A1E8
- Disconnecting while establishing a connection to host caused some bugginess
- Error central if removing most items from loadout, leaving only consumables
- Unaffordable traps didn't get dimmed out if still in prepare phase
- Lots of interface fixes
- Monsters in level details now look better
- Infinite ammo belt hopefully fixed
- A1E7 had a broken ceiling
- Switching to previous / next item will not auto-consume a pill
- Nutcracker moving part was a bit off center
- Previewed heroes' hand particles appearing in the background in the arsenal

CHANGES:
- Different sound effects for UI buttons
- UI redesigned and rewritten from scratch
- Improved brightness/contrast

ADDITIONS:
- Contours graphics option, can make enemies easier to see
- "Owned" filter in arsenal menu
- Narrator voice lines for deleting a character
- Additional narrators: Allen, Dane

BALANCE:
- Pickups slightly more frequent
- Gold rewards rebalanced for every monster type
- More gold for harder variations of enemies
- All levels rebalanced for around 25% more enemies with 25% less health

notes.title: Update 0.13.6
notes.content:
Lots of fixes and small additions but most of all, multiplayer will suffer from a lot less disconnects now.

FIXES:
- Wrong particle size on "buy skin" button
- Explosions throwing enemies are now calculated better
- Visual glitches when reloading bullet weapons
- Camera clipping through walls should happen less
- Rare cases where mouse buttons could get stuck
- Fall damage registering differently than other damage
- Another player's trap placement hovering should now show upgraded range
- Paladin armor became blue on A1E7
- Networking is a lot less disconnecty now
- One Claymore skin was uninteractable

CHANGES:
- Show name of trap you're looking at (or placing)
- If trap cannot be placed, show reason in red text
- Optimized player input over network
- Experimentally slightly better physics
- Less force on player ragdoll from walking in a direction while dying

ADDITIONS:
- Network quality option when hosting
- Dry sound effect when firing with empty magazine
- Narrator chiming in if trying to sell a trap in the wrong phase
- Option to show traps' cooldown timers in-game
- Show spent currency per item/hero directly from arsenal item list
- New video option to help against screaming GPUs (Limit FPS)

BALANCE:
- Soldier upgrade - Accuracy (when max upgraded): +30% -> +40%.
- Soldier upgrade - Reload mana cost (when max upgraded): -30% -> -45%.
- Moved back some item, effect and vanity points to earlier stars on a few levels
- Increased par time on A1E3. A1E8 now a bit easier for 3 players
- Many small buffs and nerfs to Boomstick

notes.title: Update 0.13.5
notes.content:
This update has many tiny UI things but also some needed balance changes for new player experience.

FIXES:
- Consuming a red or blue pill made health/mana wrong value
- Arsenal list box (in lobby) didn't scroll correctly
- Visual issue when dragging a curio from the arsenal

CHANGES:
- Only show the best quality model of items while previewing them in Arsenal
- Continuous effects (e.g. on fire, bleeding) don't cause neverending grunts from enemies anymore
- Updated Unity version
- More subtle lava splashes
- Items in lobby and arsenal are slightly easier to look at
- Got rid of the Unity splash screen
- Smoother animations for Skeleton and Ghoul

BALANCE:
- Trusty sidekicks - Reload cost: 9 -> 8.
- Enemy HP in multiplayer now a bit lower

notes.title: Update 0.13.4
notes.content:
This is mainly a graphics update that introduces fog and volumetric lighting to the game, which makes it quite a bit prettier to look at.
There are also some smaller bug fixes and UI changes.

FIXES:
- Newly bought traps lost their highlighted grid if in level countdown
- A description box with bad text could appear in hero selection
- Electrum spazzed out if locked onto an enemy entering a portal
- Reset pickup counter correctly between games

ADDITIONS:
- Fog effect (togglable in video settings)
- Volumetric lights (togglable in video settings)
- Setting for disabling mandatory help texts
- Pulsing effect on "Create character" button when starting with a new hero

BALANCE:
- Level 8 is now just a little easier

notes.title: Update 0.13.3
notes.content:
This is mostly a patch for new players.
The game IS meant to be challenging but not while navigating the in-game menu.

FIXES:
- Ugly artifact behind company logo removed
- Enemies could leap a bit forward after being unfrozen
- Projectile collision fix (visual)
- Bad rounding in screen refresh rates

CHANGES:
- Slight animation change in intro
- Tutorial screen now shows one help box at a time
- Made level description text for a1e1 more clear
- Be super clear about upgrades not available before first level
- More clear headings in UI and item descriptions
- If defeated and in normal difficulty, get a tip to try casual difficulty

BALANCE:
- Casual difficulty - Enemy health: 80% -> 75%.
- Increased most pill consumable effects

notes.title: Update 0.13.2
notes.content:
I'm hard at work with development on act 2.
This patch is for existing content though.

FIXES:
- Typos
- Cutscenes were not playing in intended 25 fps if VSync is enabled
- The game should look better now in very wide resolutions

CHANGES:
- Changed a hover text to be more clear about acts 2 and 3 not yet available in Early Access
- Clicking your ready status button as client now does the same thing as the "Make ready" button in the top right
- Moved player 4's starting position on a1e2 (to prevent from falling down stairs the first thing that happens)
- Hero colors default ON in minimap for new players
- Pressing Escape now exits ready if you're a client that is ready
- Trusty sidekicks - Grenade explosions now look a bit more impactful. They will also more clearly show effective blast area.
- Exploding player projectiles will give nearby enemies a visual pain reaction

ADDITIONS:
- Auto refresh on Steam lobbies for client (every 15 seconds if not manually refreshing lobby list)

BALANCE:
- Trusty sidekicks - Grenade radius: 2.9m -> 2.75m

notes.title: Update 0.13.1
notes.content:
Super small but slightly important patch:

FIXES:
- Cutscene after first act was a bit broken
